papers.title: Fine-Grained Structural Classification of Biosynthetic Gene Cluster-Encoded Products
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) are responsible the biosynthesis of many natural products, including a multitude of effective therapeutics and their precursors. Advances in genomic data collection as well as computational techniques have made it possible to identify BGCs at scale. However, accurately determining the types of BGC-encoded products from genomic content remains elusive. Results Here, we introduce BGCat (BGC annotation tool), a machine learning method for fine-grained structural classification of BGC-encoded products, leveraging the NPClassifier natural product nomenclature. Our method leverages a pre-trained protein language model for creating meaningful gene representations and a deep neural network for class label prediction. We show the method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in coarse-grained product classification and is effective for detailed classification. We implement a clustering-based augmentation strategy for BGC-product relationships, addressing a crucial gap in the available datasets. We then introduce the concept of product class profiles (PCPs) of gene cluster families (GCFs), associating each GCF with a probabilisitc distribution of product types and offering a new perspective on GCF functions. Lastly, we use BGCat to provide new product class labels for over 100k BGCs in antiSMASH DB that presently have minimal information about their products. Availability and Implementation The source code and trained model weights are freely available at https://github.com/HassounLab/BGCat

papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要与动机**  
生物合成基因簇负责多种天然产物的生物合成，这些产物包括众多具有治疗作用的药物及其前体。随着基因组数据收集技术及计算方法的进步，人们已能够大规模识别这类基因簇。然而，仅凭基因组信息准确判断这些基因簇所编码产物的具体类型仍然是一个挑战。  

**研究结果**  
我们开发了BGCat这一机器学习工具，该工具利用NPClassifier天然产物命名体系，对生物合成基因簇所编码的产物进行精细的结构分类。该方法结合预训练的蛋白质语言模型生成有意义的基因表征，并通过深度神经网络进行类别预测。实验结果表明，BGCat在粗粒度产物分类方面优于现有方法，在细粒度分类中也表现出优异性能。我们还采用基于聚类的数据增强策略来完善相关数据集，弥补了现有数据集中的关键缺陷。此外，我们提出了“产物类别谱”这一概念，将每个基因簇家族与多种产物类型的概率分布关联起来，从而为理解这些基因簇的功能提供了新的视角。最后，我们利用BGCat为antiSMASH数据库中超过10万个生物合成基因簇的产物类型提供了准确的分类标签——这些基因簇目前关于其产物的信息极为有限。  

**代码与资源**  
源代码及训练好的模型权重可免费获取，链接如下：  
https://github.com/HassounLab/BGCat

**可用性与实现方式**：源代码及训练好的模型权重可免费获取，链接为：https://github.com/HassounLab/BGCat。

all_papers.title: Fine-Grained Structural Classification of Biosynthetic Gene Cluster-Encoded Products
all_papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) are responsible the biosynthesis of many natural products, including a multitude of effective therapeutics and their precursors. Advances in genomic data collection as well as computational techniques have made it possible to identify BGCs at scale. However, accurately determining the types of BGC-encoded products from genomic content remains elusive. Results Here, we introduce BGCat (BGC annotation tool), a machine learning method for fine-grained structural classification of BGC-encoded products, leveraging the NPClassifier natural product nomenclature. Our method leverages a pre-trained protein language model for creating meaningful gene representations and a deep neural network for class label prediction. We show the method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in coarse-grained product classification and is effective for detailed classification. We implement a clustering-based augmentation strategy for BGC-product relationships, addressing a crucial gap in the available datasets. We then introduce the concept of product class profiles (PCPs) of gene cluster families (GCFs), associating each GCF with a probabilisitc distribution of product types and offering a new perspective on GCF functions. Lastly, we use BGCat to provide new product class labels for over 100k BGCs in antiSMASH DB that presently have minimal information about their products. Availability and Implementation The source code and trained model weights are freely available at https://github.com/HassounLab/BGCat

all_papers.primary_summary_raw:
MOTIVATION: Biosynthetic gene clusters (BGCs) are responsible the biosynthesis of many natural products, including a multitude of effective therapeutics and their precursors. Advances in genomic data collection as well as computational techniques have made it possible to identify BGCs at scale. However, accurately determining the types of BGC-encoded products from genomic content remains elusive.

RESULTS: Here, we introduce BGCat (BGC annotation tool), a machine learning method for fine-grained structural classification of BGC-encoded products, leveraging the NPClassifier natural product nomenclature. Our method leverages a pre-trained protein language model for creating meaningful gene representations and a deep neural network for class label prediction. We show the method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in coarse-grained product classification and is effective for detailed classification. We implement a clustering-based augmentation strategy for BGC-product relationships, addressing a crucial gap in the available datasets. We then introduce the concept of product class profiles (PCPs) of gene cluster families (GCFs), associating each GCF with a probabilisitc distribution of product types and offering a new perspective on GCF functions. Lastly, we use BGCat to provide new product class labels for over 100k BGCs in antiSMASH DB that presently have minimal information about their products.

AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The source code and trained model weights are freely available at https://github.com/HassounLab/BGCat.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary Data are available at Bioinformatics online.
